text: そんな　ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこうで　たたかうなあーっ！

structure.jp: そんな　ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこうで

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a rough order not to do it. Here it is shouted and drawn out. たたかうなあー = 'don't fight!'

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこう
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこう = 'a getup that is flashy'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here says in what state something is done. かっこうで = 'dressed in that getup'.
